verdict.rationale: Steel's docs reference a first-party Files API for managing files on Steel, which suggests a product-native mechanism for file artifacts. The pack contains only a one-line index mention, with no detail on how files are handled. Screenshot/PDF capture and trace ZIP exports are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented upload of files into sites, documented capture of files downloaded during a session, documented retrieval of artifacts after the session, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards

citations.quote: Explore API Endpoints for managing Files on Steel.
